description: Na₃Sb₅O₁₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pba2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.86 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.65 Å. There are five inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-58°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.10 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-58°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.18 Å. In the third Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-52°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.13 Å. In the fourth Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-56°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.10 Å. In the fifth Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-56°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.07 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Sb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Sb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Sb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two Sb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Sb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Sb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to one Na and three Sb atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two Sb atoms. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sb atoms.
